append.detail: 2026-11-17 (owner: "A rewrite the HYG-209 probe to measure in-process"): on #5158 the probe burned 10.94s of CPU on CI, over the 6.5s per-probe ceiling. It never spawned a suite; the cost was scripts/lib/retired-member-shell.mjs rescanning a 190 KB generated string (app/(brief)/how/brief-html.ts) from every embedded escaped quote, because any backslash made a literal a candidate. A literal is now a candidate only when it holds the basename verbatim or an escape that can decode to a letter, digit or hyphen (\u, \x, octal, identity escapes, line continuations); \n \t \" and the like cannot spell a path. That file drops from 3.4s to 0.3s locally. Same consequence measured, same ceiling, and the planted \u006d, \m and \x2d escape controls still report the edge.
